title: TrueNorth course instructor pack (content/courses/instructor/<course file stem>.yaml)
description: Staff-only material for one authored course: timings, answer-key notes, lab setup and common faults. It lives in a sibling file, never in the course YAML, because the course YAML is what Students see. scripts/load_content.py loads only content/courses/*.yaml, and app.course_content_ingest refuses any document with audience staff_only, so a pack can never be imported as learner content (the same split as the instructor part of a course release bundle). scripts/check_course.py checks that the pack exists and is complete.

timings.description: One entry per module of the course, by ordinal.

answer_key_notes.description: One entry per module: why each keyed answer is right and what the distractors test.

lab_setup.description: One entry per module: what the instructor prepares on the range before the lab.
